productivity, utilizing machine and manpower.

4.Machine investment for improving capacity and reliability.
5.Improving the knowledge and soft & hard skills.
6.Advancing the business position through R&D investment.
7.Market expansion: EV & new alliance from China.
8.Sustainability focus.

-USA/Europe Market through Chinese partners i.e. printer, home appliance, electronic.
-EVs, by using our reference products of current customers .
-Local customers expansion
